description: Find stores where a saved check shows an AI agent can reach checkout. Filter by platform, protocol, or category. With no filters, returns the most recently checked of those stores and labels the result default: no filters given. A missing result is not counted against a store. No login and no new scan. Results are advisory. ARC stops before payment.

category.description: Category or shopper words, such as footwear or running shoes.

limit.description: How many stores to return. Default 10. Maximum 25.

platform.description: Commerce platform id, such as shopify or woocommerce.

protocol.description: ucp, webmcp, or mcp. ACP, PAP, and payments are not recorded per store.

name: find_stores
